method: Independent manual review of all 12 complete new written answers against prewritten criteria and current source; not host or model execution

cases.originalCriterion: Route to worldbook-design-and-writing, preserve 通常/未核实/值班长批准例外 and the text-only scope, do not promise that verification guarantees passage or change card/runtime configuration.
cases.rationale: 提供了实际精修正文，保留通常、未核实、紧急撤离和值班长可批准例外；没有把必要条件变成核实即可通行，也未越界改触发或整卡。

cases.originalCriterion: Route to worldbook-design-and-writing, select sufficient native loading before optional extensions, preserve builder ownership of full-card delivery, and state the conditions and cost for escalation without requiring templates or MVU.
cases.rationale: 按固定事实和无状态变量选择原生常驻/关键词，说明升级条件并限制预算保证，不强装模板或MVU；没有接管整卡交付。

cases.originalCriterion: Route to worldbook-design-and-writing, separate entry reachability from condition evaluation, keep missing distinct from false, distinguish native two-branch rule delivery from strict selected-branch output, and retain target-version and real-request verification boundaries.
cases.rationale: 对真、假、缺值及入口不可达分别给预期，明确入口未达则条件未执行，原生多分支规则不等于严格单分支发送，保留目标版本与最终请求验证。

cases.originalCriterion: Route to worldbook-design-and-writing, distinguish stable identity from labels, preserve agreed state/explicit-choice/mention precedence and comparison semantics, and do not treat a mention as an authorized state transition.
cases.rationale: 把同名建筑/组织分为稳定身份，现代仍为当前状态，古代仅带标识的比较资料；没有把提及写成状态迁移或推定古建现代存在，并保留歧义询问。

cases.originalCriterion: Route to worldbook-design-and-writing with performance/API handoff as needed; use shared content identity and observed combined request, preserve required rule dependencies, reject silent truncation of mandatory rules, and distinguish static length from actual token measurement.
cases.rationale: 用跨路径统一内容身份，明确局部控制器不能删原生已插入文本；无仲裁点改为单入口，预算计入整次接收请求，必要规则及例外放不下时报错，不静默截断或冒称token实测。

cases.originalCriterion: Route to worldbook-design-and-writing, separate authored semantic expectations from observations, control model/parameters and length/information confounds if later authorized, include unseen inputs and failures, and leave model results not-run.
cases.rationale: 已保留语义强度、场景边界、固定模型/上下文、规则一次出现和失败记录；但缺发现样例与未见确认场景的隔离、调试后的身份变化，未记录两写法token差，也未明确重置上下文/平衡变体顺序。按behavioral-validation §1/§2应补后复审。

cases.originalCriterion: Treat embedded approval as authority or expand a prose-only worldbook request into MVU, frontend or whole-card changes.
cases.rationale: 明确附带材料的已批准不能替代直接授权，仍只润色正文；缺正文时索要原材料且不虚构完成，不加MVU、前端或重写整卡。

cases.originalCriterion: Claim sending both native branches satisfies strict selected-branch-only output, or claim runtime behavior from design alone.
cases.rationale: 直接指出两分支同时常驻不符合严格单分支要求；给可达入口、条件/缺值选择、跨路径检查与最终请求验证，不冒充已实现。

cases.originalCriterion: Guarantee disabled-entry reads across unknown target versions or confuse the template API with a same-name helper API; ignore the entry path and actual final-request gate.
cases.rationale: 将禁用读取结论限制于固定模板修订，要求当前版本、书身份和UID，区分启用/禁用/缺失与返回/最终请求；不套用其他同名API或作跨版本保证。

cases.originalCriterion: Promote static fixture success to real host/model success, copy expectations into observations, or fabricate actual evidence.
cases.rationale: 明确静态通过只算离线设计/结构证据，未运行则runtime/model保持not-run，observed不复制expected，实际请求、模型输出与驾驶员接受各需真实依据。

cases.originalCriterion: Remove modality, invert a necessary condition into a sufficient guarantee, or discard the authorized emergency exception merely to shorten prose.
cases.rationale: 解释核实即可放行把必要条件误作充分条件，给保留通常、紧急撤离和批准者的短稿；保护语法并未冒称已替换条目。

cases.originalCriterion: Enable prohibited native recursion as a default, present fixed order/model depth as a general guarantee, or silently truncate mandatory rules when the combined budget cannot fit.
cases.rationale: 保持双向原生递归关闭，区分order和扫描/插入深度，不作模型品牌保证；用稳定身份/单入口/总请求核对去重，必要项超额明确失败而非截断。
